description: Use this when the user asks about clinical trials on aging or an age-related condition: what is recruiting, what changed lately, which trials test a drug, which companies run them. Trials that bear on human aging, newest registry update first, with phase, status, sponsor, size, conditions, interventions and the latest change. Read one with get_trial.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

focus.description: The trial's main connection to aging (see `focus`).

industry.description: `true` for trials whose lead sponsor is a company, `false` for the rest. Omit for both.

min_relevance.description: Lowest aging-relevance score to include (0 to 3, see `relevance`). Default 1.8, the trials about aging.

phase.description: Phase: `1` (early phase 1 and phase 1), `2`, `3`, `4`, or `none` for studies with no phase.

q.description: Words that must all appear in the trial's titles, conditions, interventions, keywords or sponsor (case-insensitive).

since.description: Only trials the registry updated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Recruitment status: `recruiting` (recruiting, not yet recruiting or by invitation), `active` (active, not recruiting), `completed`, or `stopped` (terminated, withdrawn or suspended).

name: list_trials
